messages:
jen: Quick heads up — preparing the midnight private installer RC rollout (private-installer:v1.6.0). Targeting a 00:30 UTC staggered escort handoff to vendor mirrors. Need final pin + fast-fail rules before I kick the deploy-bot.
marco: Ack. Are we pinning the full image digest or using a shrinkwrap manifest?
jen: Pin full digest for this RC. Shrinkwrap is still flaky for older airgap agents. Use cosign-signed OCI manifest + sha256 in the release artifact metadata.
sara: I pushed the cosign bundle to the staging signer bucket. Signature TTL set to 48h. Manual rotate if we exceed that.
leo: Quick checklist: 1) image digest pinned in release.json 2) cosign sig present 3) transport checksum in escort manifest 4) deploy-bot window set. Anything else?
jen: Add: documented rollback trigger and quick-fail criteria in the thread — we don't want long manual rollbacks through carrier. I'll paste the short policy below.
jen: Rollback / fast-fail criteria (short):
```
- If canary 1 (3 hosts) error-rate > 10% for 10m -> pause rollout
- If canary 2 (10 hosts) error-rate > 5% for 15m -> roll back to prev tagged digest
- If cosign verify fails on > 1 host -> abort and quarantine artifacts
- If staging signer TTL expired -> abort and notify security
```
marco: Good. For the prev tagged digest, which tag do we consider authoritative? release-stable:v1.5.9?
leo: Yes, release-stable:v1.5.9 (digest pinned). Deploy-bot will fall back to that digest automatically if rollback invoked.
packaging-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: window 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z -> 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z; canary groups: [3,10,full]; image: private-installer:v1.6.0@sha256:89b4...3f2; signer: cosign:v0.19.
deploy-bot: Executing preflight checks...
ops-oncall: Quick note — networking team confirmed mirror ingress at 00:20 UTC, but vendor courier needs the escort manifest by 23:45 UTC.
sara: Sending manifest now (S3 link: https://s3.redwood/internal/rcs/1.6.0/escort-manifest.json). Please verify checksum: `md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e`.
leo: Received. Running local verify:
```
cosign verify-blob --key $SIGNER_KEY escort-manifest.json
sha256sum escort-manifest.json
```
leo: All good locally. Two small operational asks: 1) keep the first canary hosts on the same AZ for cache warmup; 2) enable verbose agent logs for 30m post-canary.
jen: noted. deploy-bot — enable verbose-agent-logs flag for canary groups and set AZ affinity for group 1.
deploy-bot: Flags applied: `--verbose-agents --az-affinity=group1`. Canary 1 scheduled in 25m.
marco: If canary 1 looks good, what's our manual approval window before canary 2?
jen: 15m observation + optional manual hold. If anyone types `hold` in this thread within that window I'll pause automatic progression.
sara: I will watch metrics. Ops-oncall will stand by to escalate.
ops-oncall: Oncall here. If rollback happens, I'll coordinate the carrier revert and signer revocation. Notify me with `@ops-oncall rollback` to trigger emergency flow.
leo: One last: document release notes snippet for the customer-facing package about the pin and cosign verification steps so integrators know how to validate offline. I'll draft and push to the release notes repo.
jen: Perfect. Plan: I will trigger the deploy-bot at 00:30 UTC unless we hit any last-minute issues. If you see anything odd react with :eyes: or `hold`.
marco: :thumbsup:
sara: :eyes:
packaging-bot: preflight complete. All artifacts present, signer OK.
deploy-bot: Canary 1 started. Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/3419876543/1
jen: Monitoring. If I see >5% 502s I'm calling rollback.
leo: Watching metrics dashboard now.
ops-oncall: Standby; I'll prep the revert manifest just in case.
packaging-bot: Note: if we trigger rollback, we must also revoke the temporary signer token — run `kms revoke-token --id signer-temp-341987`.
jen: Copy. Keep this thread for the handoff record. If all green after canary 2, I'll announce full rollout and update release-stable pointer.
marco: Thanks everyone, syncing on-call and mirrors.
jen: launching in 2m...
deploy-bot: Canary 1 complete: success (0.6% error-rate). Progressing to canary 2 in 10m unless hold received.
jen: proceeding.
marco: Nice.
